strings.notes: 源基 not in 0719; US contact Sailor Huey (US 0674)

strings.zh: 你真行啊！{NEWLINE}我已经很久没有输过了！{SCROLL}对了！{NEWLINE}把你电话号码告诉给我吧。{SCROLL}有你在就能进行很多场{NEWLINE}精彩的对战了,{CLEAR}这样我就能变得更强！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You’re really good! I haven’t lost in{NEWLINE}ages! Oh, I know!{SCROLL}Give me your phone number.{SCROLL}With you around, we can{NEWLINE}have lots of great battles,{CLEAR}and that’ll make me stronger! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0674/1 | RV072: meaning: battles with the player make him stronger (D-2002); layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 我看你⋯⋯{NEWLINE}根本就是个懦夫。
把你电话号码告诉给我吧。{SCROLL}有你在就能进行很多场{NEWLINE}精彩的对战了,{CLEAR}这样我就能变得更强！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Give me your phone number.{SCROLL}With you around, we can{NEWLINE}have lots of great battles,{CLEAR}and that’ll make me stronger! {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0674/4 | RV072: meaning: battles with the player make him stronger (D-2002); layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 可恶！{NEWLINE}还是那么厉害⋯⋯{SCROLL}我和{VAR:0103:0}进行了{NEWLINE}那么多场的对战,{CLEAR}可还是没有一点胜算⋯⋯{SCROLL}亏我还买了那么多的药,{NEWLINE}这是为什么呢？{SCROLL}莫非,药⋯⋯　{NEWLINE}并不代表一切⋯⋯{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}！这个给你！{NEWLINE}我已经用不着了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Damn! You’re as tough as ever...{SCROLL}I’ve battled you so many{NEWLINE}times, {VAR:0103:0}, and I still{CLEAR}don’t stand a chance...{SCROLL}I even bought all that{NEWLINE}medicine. Why isn’t it working?{SCROLL}Could it be... that medicine{NEWLINE}isn’t everything...?{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}! Take this! I won’t{NEWLINE}be needing it anymore!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0674/5 | tone review: 可恶 from adult Sailor Huey: 'Damn!' (D-0627)

strings.zh: 在灯塔里打电话{NEWLINE}回响声很大,{CLEAR}感觉挺有意思的！
strings.en: Wow, when you call from inside the{NEWLINE}Lighthouse, your voice just kind of{CLEAR}echoes. It’s kind of cool!

strings.zh: 你的精灵们{NEWLINE}现在还好吗？{SCROLL}我的精灵有点精神过头了,{NEWLINE}搞得我有点不知所措了！{SCROLL}特别是{VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}一看到训练师{CLEAR}就要冲上去！{CLEAR}那劲头势不可挡啊！{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: How are your Pokémon doing?{NEWLINE}My Pokémon are a bit too energetic.{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:10}, especially.{SCROLL}Every time it spots a Trainer, it just{NEWLINE}charges ahead into battle!{SCROLL}It gets to be a bit much for me!{NEWLINE}Later!

strings.zh: 我的{VAR:0100:10}比以前{NEWLINE}更加强壮了！{SCROLL}看上好像比我都强了！{SCROLL}再见！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s looking tougher{NEWLINE}than ever.{SCROLL}It looks even tougher than me!{NEWLINE}Later!

strings.zh: 喂,再来一场对战吧！{NEWLINE}我可不会再和上次一样了！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}等你,{NEWLINE}给我快点过来！
strings.en: Hey, I challenge you to a battle!{NEWLINE}It won’t be like last time!{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}’s where I’m waiting{NEWLINE}for you. Hustle over here pronto!

strings.zh: 喂！你应该没忘记{NEWLINE}和我的对战吧！{SCROLL}地点是{VAR:0104:3}！{NEWLINE}快来吧！我等好久了！
strings.en: Hey, you’d better not have forgotten{NEWLINE}about our battle!{SCROLL}{VAR:0104:3}!{NEWLINE}Hustle over quick! I’m waiting!

strings.zh: 再来对战吧！{NEWLINE}我会一直挑战你,{CLEAR}直到把你打倒为止！
strings.en: We have to battle again sometime.{NEWLINE}You can bet I’m going to keep{CLEAR}challenging you till I win.
